findings.analysis: Use ROADMAP and existing topic docs; do not install root specs, mandatory reading chain or MEMORY_LONG. The quoted 38 suites are stale: source has53. Attachments supply proposals, not authority.

Use append-only journal and idempotent completed-transfer receipts. Include cash+savings+business+community fund in conserved stock; tax is an internal transfer, not destruction. Declare wage/boost external sources and costs/sinks. Guard stock=0, bound demand/time windows; set inflation metrics on prices, not total cash/basePrice. No5% annual claim from60days. Initialization/immigration cash must be an explicit issuance/funded transfer. Demand/stock formula with nonnegative demand cannot reach the proposed lower0.8 multiplier; define shortage/surplus and stock flow before claiming market pricing.

No scenario drink-stall in current41-action catalog; planner learning does not pay wages. Existing bounded core moneyDelta event path must be reconciled, not silently replaced by NPC wallet defaults. No automatic taxes or wallet migration. Any proposed2%tax/30%pension are fictional simulation parameters, not Vietnamese tax/pension facts.

Reuse60 door anchors/home/household IDs, persisted identity and current catalog population expansion. No second immigration loop. Vacant housing can accept residents only with explicit capacity/ownership policy; proposal rule otherwise contradicts vacancy. Moving never deletes actors/history/pets or owner assignments.

Derive mastery from relevant domain, not scalar all-purpose skill. Existing8 domain skills already differentiate practice. Mentorship needs both actors confirmed participation and own completed outcomes; consent/ETA/text are not earned sessions. Define shift/contract authority before pay. Retirement/pension require explicit lifecycle design and funded accounting.

Template/curated fiction is editorial-authored, never invented human authorship. Separate public availability, reading, hearing and witnessing. Every hop needs confirmed sharing, source chain, dedup and bounded decay. Bulletin read must not restore confidence to1 or convert gossip into observed truth. No blanket LLM ban needed for separately labeled reviewed narrative. Confidence is a propagation heuristic, not a calibrated probability of truth; indirect hearing never becomes direct witness.

Deterministic bounded groups after bonds and authority; pairwise meeting evidence, distinct members and collision-free IDs. Projects reserve/spend fund atomically and complete with authoritative effect receipt. Dissolution retains historical membership/events. Two-speaker dialogue contract remains until multi-party design exists.

Current health is numeric, not health.conditions object. Additive versioned health metadata only after design; do not replace numeric field. Care needs confirmed receiver/caregiver completed effects and idempotency; no clinical claims or automatic medical expertise. Family/children remain outside current scope.

Publicly available does not mean every actor witnessed. Keep availability, direct witness and heard-from source distinct; enforce actor/witness scope before retrieval and prompt. No public route/audience change. Reputation derives from attributable receipts and cannot award own trials. Preserve full audit/history; bounded snapshot indexes are separate.

Six months and p<.01 alone do not validate a norm. Control multiple testing, temporal/actor dependence, confounding, effect size and untouched holdout; simulation rules can manufacture correlations. Hash/schema provenance, dry-run and explicit review before rule changes. No auto law/code/deploy, no MEMORY_LONG.

Bound active working sets and cache; preserve durable money/care/news/memory/outcome journals instead of deleting history after30/90/365days. Dry-run returns proposed deltas without world/policy writes. Audit failure must abort the whole CAS batch and surface error; swallowing errors does not roll back transactions.

Keep WP20–27 as future roadmap with prerequisites, not immediate implementation and not literal dependency on all WP0–19 completion. Ground authority is a dependency for earned meetings/care/transfer, while offline prototypes and provenance can progress independently.
